evidence.title: USACE MVK-2025-00855: named Highway 3 Technology Park Project Site and embedded map georeference
evidence.publisher: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Vicksburg District; applicant mapping by Headwaters for Bohler Engineering
evidence.attribution: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Vicksburg District; Headwaters / Bohler Engineering applicant map
evidence.excerpt: The Corps notice publishes the named Highway 3 Technology Park project map, with a smaller Project Site path and its embedded coordinate reference system.

metadata.literal_pointer: PDF page 1 notice date, applicant and road/section locality; page 2 six-building proposal; page 3 applicant-information caveat; page 5 Site Location Map and /VP[0]/Measure; pages 6 and 8 corroborating project-area and conceptual-plan scope.
metadata.visual_review_scope: Complete relevant rendered pages; text and PDF dictionaries independently cross-checked. No satellite analysis, new imagery review or reproduction of the source pages.
metadata.source_map_title: Site Location Map / Highway 3 Technology Park
metadata.date_semantics: April 16, 2026 is the public-notice publication date; December 22, 2025 is the map date. Neither is a selected physical construction observation. The notice is an application for comment, not an issued permit; its historical undisturbed/forested-site statement is not substituted for the separately selected June 10 operator observation.
metadata.authority_basis: Government-published applicant submission. Page 3 expressly says applicant information has not been verified or evaluated for regulatory compliance; the stated Corps verification concerns the geographic extent of jurisdictional or presumed-jurisdictional aquatic resources only. No broader Corps validation of the applicant project boundary, coordinates, design, ownership or construction is inferred.

identity_bridge.locality: West of Highway 3 and north of Lone Oak Drive, Bossier Parish, Louisiana
identity_bridge.reasoning: The parish proceedings identify STACK and Amazon with the same park, Bohler applicant, road locality and six-building development on lots 3 and 4. The Corps notice and attached conceptual plan describe that same six-building Highway 3 project. The five plat lots, six buildings, switchyard, future lease area and excess land remain one physical-campus identity, not separate additions.
identity_bridge.section_discrepancy: The map title prints Section 2, T21N, R13W, while the parish proceedings identify Section 32, T21N, R13W. This discrepancy remains unresolved. The smaller selected project area and notice text are in Section 5, T20N, R13W; the identity bridge does not depend on silently correcting the northern section label.

selected_path.extracted_coordinate_space: PDF page points as delivered by pdfplumber: x from page left and y from page top; page rotation is zero and CropBox equals MediaBox.
selected_path.classification_guardrail: Select the black dashed 335-point Project Site path, not the red 26-point Site Boundary, vicinity inset, legend swatch, white off-page dashed graphic, future lease area or whole viewport. The source path contains straight line operations, not an inferred raster trace.

georeference.source_dictionary_pointer: PDF page 5 /VP[0] named Map, /Measure with /Subtype /GEO; /VP[1] Vicinity Inset is excluded.
georeference.viewport_bbox_order: lower-left x, lower-left y, upper-right x, upper-right y
georeference.gpts_coordinate_semantics: Degrees of latitude then longitude in the geographic CRS underlying GCS, established by Adobe ExtensionLevel 3 Table 8.111a. They are not initially assumed WGS84.
georeference.source_geographic_crs: NAD83(2011), as defined by the GEOGCS nested in the exact embedded WKT.
georeference.source_projected_crs: NAD83(2011) / Louisiana North, US survey feet
georeference.crs_derivation: Read the exact embedded WKT. EPSG:6477 is a library-recognized equivalence, not a replacement input. The selected transformation pipeline and software versions are retained below.
georeference.precision_scope: Retain the embedded numeric control values, including values serialized with fewer than five fractional digits. Their numeric precision is not a positional-accuracy guarantee.

numerical_reproduction.coordinate_order: Source projected pairs are easting/northing in US survey feet; output is WGS84 longitude/latitude.
numerical_reproduction.geographic_controls_to_grid: Transform each GPTS longitude/latitude pair from the geographic CRS underlying the embedded WKT into that same projected WKT before interpolation.
numerical_reproduction.interpolation_method: Bilinear interpolation in source projected units at the four LPTS corners; weights in retained control order are (1-u)*(1-v), (1-u)*v, u*v, u*(1-v).
numerical_reproduction.interpolation_scope: An explicit calculation choice using all four source controls, not a claim that Adobe mandates this interpolation algorithm. No raster geocoding, snapping, area fitting, hidden map-provider point or coordinate-precision override.
numerical_reproduction.representative_point_method: Shapely representative_point of the explicitly make_valid-normalized project polygon, in native projected units, then transformed and rounded. The original ring yields the identical interior point.

topology_audit.normalization: Shapely make_valid; preserve the original 335 source PDF points above. No simplification, snapping, area-fitting or hidden replacement of the source path.
topology_audit.limitation: A tiny self-touch at the road-access tip produces one small hole. The negligible area delta is numerical noise, not evidence of survey accuracy. Neither original nor repaired polygon is selected as a release boundary.

numerical_reproduction.source_area_scope: Derived map area only, not a normalized surveyed-area, capacity or construction-progress metric.
numerical_reproduction.control_residual_scope: Numerical consistency diagnostic over the four projected controls only, not source or survey positional accuracy.
numerical_reproduction.source_to_wgs84_transformation: Inverse of SPCS83 Louisiana North zone (US survey foot) + NAD83(2011) to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
numerical_reproduction.source_to_wgs84_pipeline: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=us-ft xy_out=m step inv proj=lcc lat_0=30.5 lon_0=-92.5 lat_1=32.6666666666667 lat_2=31.1666666666667 x_0=999999.99998984 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
numerical_reproduction.operation_accuracy_scope: Accuracy reported for the datum operation; not the positional accuracy of the drawing, its control points or the selected campus locator.
numerical_reproduction.independent_reproduction: Two independent read-only implementations re-extracted the PDF path and controls and reproduced the same five-decimal point. An independently solved bilinear basis differed from the original native vertices by less than 1e-8 US survey feet and yielded identical unrounded WGS84 coordinates.
numerical_reproduction.portable_reproduction_scope: The selected project path and all required controls are included in this compact factual projection. The ignored calculation files and source PDF are local verification custody, not redistributed release artifacts or required hidden coordinate inputs.

nonselected_context.narrative_point_guardrail: Its narrative datum is unstated; the map's embedded CRS is not silently assigned to this separate textual coordinate.
nonselected_context.scope_guardrail: The full red landholding, later final-plat acreage and conceptual lease area are not equated or area-fitted. The red polygon is used locally only for a conservative full-site duplicate check and containment diagnostic; its complete geometry is not redistributed here.

metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual project-path coordinates, georeference controls, attribution and independently derived locator only. No blanket public-domain licence is inferred for the applicant's attachments to a federal notice. The full red landholding, source map, basemaps, conceptual drawing, photographs, PDF pages, signatures, names or addresses unrelated to project identity are not redistributed.

evidence.title: Adobe PDF 1.7 ExtensionLevel 3: GEO registration, underlying geographic CRS and WKT semantics
evidence.publisher: Adobe Systems Incorporated; historical original document preserved by Internet Archive
evidence.attribution: Adobe Systems Incorporated, Adobe Supplement to ISO 32000, BaseVersion 1.7, ExtensionLevel 3, June 2008
evidence.excerpt: Adobe defines GPTS in the geographic CRS underlying GCS, pairs LPTS with the viewport unit square, and specifies WKT coordinate-system precedence.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact content-decoded HTTP response-body bytes, not extracted text, rendered pages or calculation output.
metadata.capture_method: credential-free Node fetch; no retry; content-decoded response bytes
metadata.literal_pointer: Edition cover and copyright page; complete PDF/printed pages 49-52, section 8.8.1 and Tables 8.110, 8.111a-c; implementation notes E-8/E-9 on page 131 and E-20 on page 132.
metadata.date_semantics: The edition is June 2008; publication day is not established. The archived URL timestamp and September retrieval are provenance, not publication or construction dates.

semantics.gpts: Pairs are latitude/longitude degrees in the geographic coordinate system of GCS; a projected GCS includes an underlying geographic coordinate system.
semantics.lpts: Pairs in a two-dimensional unit square correspond in order to GPTS and map to the rectangular viewport bounds.
semantics.bounds: Bounds describe where the geospatial association is valid relative to the viewport unit square. They are not a project or campus boundary.
semantics.gcs: Source projected or geographic coordinate-system dictionary; a projected dictionary includes GEOGCS.
semantics.dcs: Optional display coordinate system, distinct from source GCS. No absent WGS84 display system is invented.
semantics.wkt: The projected dictionary requires WKT or EPSG. Implementation note E-20 says an available WKT defines the coordinate system; any EPSG must be consistent. The exact source WKT is retained as input.

metadata.scope_guardrail: Only compact paraphrased coordinate-format semantics. The specification does not establish this site's identity, location accuracy, lifecycle, survey certification, ownership, rights to the applicant map, or a mandated interpolation method.
metadata.source_selection_guardrail: This is the 140-page June 2008 ExtensionLevel 3 document. The separately captured 8-page ExtensionLevel 5 supplement and the SDK-index HTML redirect are not selected as the normative GEO specification.
metadata.archive_guardrail: The source URL is an archived public copy of Adobe's original document; Internet Archive is the preservation host, not the technical author. No access gate, credentials or alternate-authentication method was used for the successful capture.
metadata.rights_scope: Adobe reserves rights in the specification. Only compact independently paraphrased technical facts and attribution are projected; no PDF pages, tables, source prose, figures or other media are redistributed.

semantics.geometry_derivation: Extract the named smaller Project Site path from the government-published applicant map; interpolate its PDF positions through the four embedded source-CRS controls, explicitly normalize the self-touching ring, take an interior representative point in source projected units, transform without ballpark operations and round the locator to five decimals.
semantics.precision_scope: Five-decimal longitude/latitude locator derived from the specifically named Project Site, not from the larger landholding or viewport. Official source means the government-published applicant submission, not Corps survey certification. This is not a surveyed building, entrance, parcel centroid, campus boundary, verified construction footprint or observed work location. Extra intermediate digits are computational precision; the two-metre datum-operation accuracy is not source positional accuracy.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The applicant drawing provides no quantitative survey or positional-accuracy estimate. Embedded five-decimal geographic controls, vector-page precision, interpolation consistency and datum-operation accuracy do not establish the accuracy of the drawing or derived locator.

distinctness_review.method: All 188 complete Point/Polygon/MultiPolygon features, including holes, compared with both the full red site polygon and normalized smaller project area using Shapely. Full properties screened case-insensitively for the listed names; no intersection or alias match.
distinctness_review.distance_scope: Candidate-centred WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant minimum full-geometry separation; a duplicate-review diagnostic, not coordinate accuracy. Entire red-site and baseline geometries are not repeated in this projection.

remaining_review_gate: Independent final source/geometry and contract review, then separately pinned acceptance, frozen-row preservation and full release validation. This proposal alone admits no campus or project and changes no accepted count.
